description:
Discover the ultimate combination of comfort, style, and electric performance in the newly upgraded EVRYjourney FAT Tire Deluxe Electric Bike. Now equipped with enhanced front suspension, a powerful front headlight, and a bright integrated brake light, this e-bike is ready to take on longer rides, rougher terrain, and evening commutes, all while keeping you safe and supported.

Designed for riders who want the joy of cycling without overexertion, this bike helps you tackle steep hills, headwinds, and extended distances with ease. The 500-watt motor is there when you need it, giving you the option to ride fully electric, engage pedal assist, or ride traditionally under your own power. Whether you're looking for a light workout or a sweat-free cruise, the choice is yours.

The ergonomic step-thru frame keeps you in a relaxed, upright position, reducing pressure on your back, hips, knees, and shoulders. Perfect for riders returning to cycling or anyone seeking a more comfortable experience, the forward pedaling design ensures easy mounting and dismounting while offering full leg extension and added stability at stops.

Now with suspension forks, the EVRYjourney absorbs more of the bumps along the way, giving you an even smoother and more controlled ride, ideal for streets, paths, and light trails. The front headlight keeps your path illuminated, while the rear brake light alerts others when you're slowing down, adding visibility and peace of mind.

Key Features:

Upgraded Suspension Fork – Smooths out bumpy roads for a more comfortable and stable ride

Integrated Front Headlight & Rear Brake Light – Ride confidently in low-light conditions

500W Motor – Ride with pedal assist or go full electric using the thumb throttle

Top Speeds – Up to 20mph on full electric and 28mph with pedal assist

500Wh Battery – Ranges up to 20 miles (full electric) and 20–40 miles (pedal assist)

26” Wheels with 4” FAT Tires – Delivers great traction and a cushioned ride

Front & Rear Disc Brakes – Reliable stopping power when you need it

Ergonomic Frame Design – Upright riding posture reduces strain on joints

Low Step-Thru Frame – Easy to mount and dismount, great for all mobility levels

Fits Riders 5'0" to 6'4" – One bike, many heights
